name: Meta Platforms
basis: each funding- or dividend-inclusive history is scaled to its own latest raw USD close

fundingForecast.displaySign: funding is peer-to-peer; positive rate: longs pay shorts; negative rate: shorts pay longs

onchainSpot.preferenceBasis: all pages display separate CEX reported-volume and contract-backed DEX execution sections
onchainSpot.volumeSource: direct Binance, Bitget, Bybit, OKX, and Meteora venue APIs plus factory-verified PancakeSwap V3 pool-event volume indexed by DexScreener; DEX quote routes without indexed pool-event volume are excluded
onchainSpot.liquiditySource: direct CEX order books; direct Ethereum, Robinhood-chain, and PancakeSwap V3 quoter depth; direct Meteora pool state; and direct Jupiter executable round-trip quotes

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

fundamentalsMethod.forwardPE: institutional consensus forward P/E; n/m when consensus EPS is negative
fundamentalsMethod.forwardSalesGrowthPct: consensus forward sales versus trailing 12m reported net sales (TRAIL_12M_NET_SALES); falls back to the locked GARP panel ratio (per-share sales x shares) when the total is not served, then to exchange filings; n/a otherwise
fundamentalsMethod.forwardEPSGrowthPct: consensus forward EPS versus trailing 12m reported EPS; trailing EPS comes from exchange filings when the data source serves none; n/m for trailing losses
fundamentalsMethod.epsRevision28dPctOfPrice: (consensus forward EPS[t] - consensus forward EPS[t-28 observations]) / last price[t] × 100; shorter window for recent listings
fundamentalsMethod.DRAMForwardPE: Official Roundhill issuer weights; physical shares plus total-return swaps; weighted positive institutional consensus forward P/E earnings yields, inverted

earningsOptions.source: consolidated listed-options chain, verified earnings calendars, and split-adjusted price history

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalEarnings.method: After-close releases use event close to next trading close. Premarket and intraday releases use prior trading close to event close; an intraday result therefore includes the full session containing the release. SEC acceptance time is used when available, with historical calendar timing as fallback.

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with verified calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
